# Critique — `docs/mockups/timeline-fishbone.html` (S9: Timeline and Fishbone, pre-build)

*2026-09-21. The mind map's last two structures (§0.10 item 24 S9; the mind-map pass left them
"once Down proves the elbow"). The mock is generated by the layout rule the build uses, on the
Garden plan sample of `mind-map.html`. Grounds measured live: Xmind's *Linea del tempo* and
*Lisca di pesce* (a new map, nothing saved). Decided in one batch after the mock: a timeline
topic's subtree is **an org chart growing away from the spine**; both structures **alternate
above and below**; the fishbone's head is **at the left**; level 2 on a rib is **text on the
line**.*

## Grounds (Xmind, native grabs at 98 – 117 %)

| what | measured | taken |
|---|---|---|
| the timeline's spine | from the central topic's right edge at its centre; the last topic + a tail | the same (`dim`, 2 dp, `SPINE_TAIL` 24) |
| main topics | alternate above and below ("Orizzontale, fuori asse"); a dot ≈ 11 px on the spine; the topic's underline 28 px from the dot's centre | a 8 dp dot in the branch's hue, a 24 dp stem to the strip |
| a topic's subtree | an indented list to the right (tree chart) | **not taken** — the org chart away from the spine (Down's layout, mirrored above), the strip at every level as the pass decided for Timeline |
| the fishbone's rib | ≈ 60° from the spine (60.2 measured), leaning forward — the topic ahead of its foot | 60° (`RIB_ANGLE_DEG`); the rib's length from its bones (`ribLength`) |
| bones | horizontal, evenly spaced along the rib, text on a line | the same: `BONE_GAP` 28, the word inset 18 from the rib, its baseline on the bone |
| the head | at the left by default ("Da sinistra a destra"); right is an option | left (the way Right, Down and Timeline grow) — the classic Ishikawa's right-hand head recorded, not taken |
| Mindomo / Freeplane | no timeline or fishbone structure (Mindomo's are templates of the same tree) | — |

## Top priorities

1. **[High · measured, fixed in the mock] Fishbone ribs collided** — the first draft advanced a
   foot by the rib's reach alone: *Compost bins'* strip overlapped *Seed order's*, *Rain
   barrel's* bone crossed *Tools'* rib. Fix (in the mock and the rule): a foot is placed after
   the same side's previous rib is **clear** — its strip's right edge and its bones' right ends
   brought back to the spine along the slope — and at least 48 dp past the last foot, so the
   order along the spine holds. The build's `tidy` carries the same two clearances.
2. **[Med · judged] A side is the node's own** — the mock alternates by order; the build reads
   the side from the topic's centre against the spine (S8's rule turned on its side), and a
   *new* child alternates. Switching a Right map to Timeline puts every topic above or below by
   where it already sat — a Tidy then interleaves whatever it finds. Recorded in §3.7; a drag
   across the spine moves a topic over, as it does across a Map's root.
3. **[Low · measured] The mock's radii and spacing sprawl** (`craftkit ui`: five radii, eleven
   spacings) are the mock's HTML, not the app's — the app draws these from the register's
   tokens and the grammar's constants (6 · 8 · 10 dp; 12 · 24 · 48 dp).

## Dimension by dimension

- **Hierarchy** — the root box, then the spine, then the topics; a timeline reads left to right by its dots; a fishbone by its feet.
- **Colour** — one hue per main branch from the register's fan (the pass's rule); the spine in `dim` as a relationship is — it belongs to no branch.
- **Type** — the strip at `body`, leaves at `body` on the line; nothing new.
- **Layout** — a timeline's slots are Down's bands; a fishbone's ribs are as long as their bones need (96 dp at least) — a topic with many bones stands higher.
- **Consistency** — Tab / Enter / Insert, folding (the badge above an up-side strip), frames following a subtree, relationships: unchanged; the two structures join the board's menu and the node's *Structure ▸* by the enum.

## What's working

- The same nodes, two more readings — no new node kind, no schema.
- A rib is derived from the topic's box alone, so a dragged topic keeps a straight rib and a bone stays on it.

## Cannot verify

- The rib at the app's stroke and density (2 dp at 60° on the Compact scale); the walk decides.
- A bone whose word is longer than the rib's forward reach — the clearance rule handles it; the eye decides whether it reads.

## What the mock says about the code

`CanvasStructure.TIMELINE` / `FISHBONE` (`curved = false`; `spine = true`); `TreeSide.UP`;
`isSpineRoot`, `spineRootOf`, `isRibTopic`; the spine geometry pure (`spineY`, `spineEnd`,
`stemAnchors`, `ribOf` / `Rib.xAt`, `ribLength`) so `tidy` and the painter agree; `tidy`'s
two spine branches and the mirrored columns; `newChildPosition` on a spine, on a rib, in a row;
the painter: the spine per spine root, a dot and a stem per timeline topic, a rib per fishbone
topic, a bone per level-2 word; `outerSide` gains UP for relationships above their parent.
